statement: Dino 8 must let users plot at a chosen standard scale, a custom paper-to-drawing units ratio, or Fit to Paper, interpreting drawing units according to the unit system.

acceptance.sketch: Plot a 1000-unit line at custom scale 1 mm = 10 units and assert it measures 100 mm on paper; Fit to Paper fills the printable area.

notes: Added from help page "About Setting the Plot Scale"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must cover plotting concepts: output to paper or electronic files, device and paper selection, and printing and plotting as equivalent CAD output.

acceptance.sketch: Plot a drawing to a PDF device and to a paper device and assert both produce output from the same plot settings.

notes: Added from help page "About Plotting"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must support plot styles as an object or layer property that overrides plotted appearance, covering color, dither, grayscale, pen assignment, screening, linetype, lineweight, transparency, line cap and join, and fill, with the override switchable.

acceptance.sketch: Assign a plot style with 0.5 mm lineweight to a layer and assert plotted objects on it use 0.5 mm, and that turning off the override restores object lineweights.

notes: Added from help page "About Plot Styles"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must support both color-dependent plot style tables with 256 fixed styles keyed by color and named plot style tables whose styles can be added and deleted, assigned to the Model tab or each layout.

acceptance.sketch: Assign a color-dependent table to a layout and assert all red objects share one style and styles cannot be added; with a named table, add a style and assign it.

notes: Added from help page "About Plot Style Tables"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must publish drawings or an entire sheet set into an electronic drawing set held in one DWF, DWFx or PDF file with several sheets.

acceptance.sketch: Publish three layouts from two drawings to a single multi-sheet PDF and assert the file has three pages in the listed order.

notes: Added from help page "About Publishing"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must create transmittal packages of drawings and their dependent files as a folder or ZIP, without executable self-extracting or password options, and support saving in earlier file versions.

acceptance.sketch: Transmit a drawing with an xref and font to a ZIP and assert both dependencies are included.

notes: Added from help page "About Transmitting Drawing Packages Electronically"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.
